concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-pay-out-to-bank-accounts-manage-bank-details]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service Checkout zero-auth bank-detail tokenization for later third-party bank payouts, with company credential/feature gates, local/cross-border limits and no account validation or receipt proof.
warnings: The source describes bank-detail tokenization, not token deletion or a PCI-compliance determination; do not import those claims from adjacent card or recipient-management guides.
Successful zero-auth authorization creates/reports a token but does not validate the bank account or prove any outbound transfer.
